newsitem.title: USA: Molten Metal to buy rest of venture.
newsitem.headline: Molten Metal to buy rest of venture.

text.p: Molten Metal Technology Inc said Thursday it has signed a letter of intent to become full owner of the waste-processing facility it jointly owns with Scientific Ecology Group Inc, a subsidiary of Westinghouse Electric Corp.
The first-of-a-kind Quantum-CEP facility in Oak Ridge, Tenn., which was commissioned in December 1995, processes certain low-level radioactive waste from nuclear power plants.
Molten Metal said the terms of the agreement are not being disclosed, and closing is subject to execution of definitive documents.

Scientific Ecology Group provides utilities, the U.S. government, and hospitals with a full range of services in the low-level radioactive waste sector throughout the United States and abroad. Westinghouse recently announced plans to sell its environmental services business line, including this subsidiary. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
